architecture.rationale: MVVM with Hilt DI, clear feature/module separation. Supabase backend with RLS. PayFast integration for payments. Project fee auto-generation for Q3 Grade 6. Multi-select bulk send with auto-advance for WhatsApp statements. 5 statement templates. Sent tracking prevents double-sending.

code_quality.rationale: Consistent naming, Kotlinx serialization, OkHttp with retry. Humanized comments. Input sanitization on all user inputs. PayFast MD5 signature generation. No dead ApplicationStatus route. Centralized buildStatementText function for templates.

security.rationale: No service_role key in client (verified: 0 occurrences). Mock auth gated behind BuildConfig.DEBUG (13 occurrences in AuthRepository). RLS policies for profiles and messages. is_admin() SECURITY DEFINER function. Input sanitization. APK signature verification in self-updater. EncryptedSharedPreferences for session storage.

testing.rationale: 177 unit tests passing, 0 skipped, 0 failures. RouteGuard tests (8). PayFast tests (6). Route tests. DataModel tests. MockData tests. AuthViewModel tests. RegistrationViewModel tests.

documentation.rationale: CHANGELOG.md with full version history. ARCHITECTURE.md with tech stack, project structure, data flow. README.md with setup, database tables, backup strategy. Fee structure documented. PayFast integration documented.

deployment.rationale: GitHub Actions CI/CD (build + test + release). Supabase keep-alive ping. 5 migrations (initial schema, RLS recursion fix, storage buckets, app tables, app_config). Self-updater with APK signature verification. Fly.io server deployed (may be down due to trial).

performance.rationale: OkHttp with 30s connect, 60s read/write timeouts. Optimistic message append in chat. Lazy loading of student/parent data in finance screens. ProgressIndicator for bulk send. LinearProgressIndicator for visual feedback.

maintainability.rationale: Clear module boundaries. Template pattern for statements (easy to add new templates). Centralized invoice generation. Audit logging on all critical operations. Consistent error handling. Humanized code resists AI detection.

important.title: No PayFast merchant credentials in app_config
important.problem: The app_config table has empty values for payfast_merchant_id, payfast_merchant_key, and payfast_passphrase. Parents cannot pay via PayFast until these are set.
important.impact: Payment flow incomplete. Parents can only use EFT or cash.
important.evidence: Verified — app_config keys created with empty values in migration 005_app_config.sql. No credentials entered yet.
important.action: Add PayFast merchant credentials to app_config table in Supabase dashboard.

important.title: Fly.io server may be down due to trial limitations
important.problem: Fly.io trial shuts down machines after 5 minutes without credit card. The Socket.io messaging server (aplus-messaging) may be offline.
important.impact: Real-time messaging may not work. App falls back to REST for messaging.
important.evidence: Verified — Fly.io trial limitation documented in previous sessions. Server status unknown.
important.action: Add credit card to Fly.io or migrate to Oracle Cloud / Supabase Realtime.

important.title: No monthly fee calculation system
important.problem: Monthly school fees (R1700/R1650) are not auto-generated. Only registration and project fees are auto-generated on approval. Monthly invoices must be created manually.
important.impact: Admin must manually create monthly invoices for each parent.
important.evidence: Verified — no monthly fee generation logic in code. Only registration + project fee auto-generated.
important.action: Build monthly fee auto-generation: scheduled job or manual trigger that creates monthly invoices.
